result:
Budget is essentially exhausted, so I'm stopping here. Summary of what shipped this session:

**Done:** compliance-tracker PR [#559](https://github.com/FChecklist/compliance-tracker/pull/559) — extends the live `compliance.prompt_templates`/`prompt_versions` tables with MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH versioning, a Draft/Review/Staging/Production/Deprecated lifecycle state machine, diff/rollback APIs, and an 18-category metadata JSON Schema. Independently audited by a fresh agent (per Rule 7c) — it found and I fixed one real regression (missing terminology-guardrail exemptions for new dated comments); the re-audit posted `AUDIT: PASS`. Knowledge registered, both success-criteria queries verified `found=1`.

**Not done (budget ran out):** CI was still finishing on the last push, and the claude-control-side deliverable (updating the phase plan's status to `done` + adding a WIRING_ENGINE_REGISTRY entry) wasn't started — it needs an isolated `git worktree` since the shared claude-control checkout has another session's unrelated in-progress edits. Both are logged in PROGRESS.md under "Remaining" and "Session budget note" for whoever picks this up next.
